exam.exam_name: Chandigarh Junior Basic Training (JBT), TGT & PGT Direct Recruitment Examination
exam.conducting_body: Education Department, Chandigarh Administration / National Institute of Technical Teachers Training (NITTTR)

source_evidence.captured_wording: Upload passport size photograph (20 KB - 50 KB) and signature (10 KB - 20 KB) in JPG format.
source_evidence.document_title: Recruitment Notice for the Posts of Junior Basic Training (JBT) and Trained Graduate Teachers (TGT)

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.
dimensions.permitted_pixel_range: 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; 20 KB to 50 KB JPG

headwear.source_wording: Turban allowed for Sikh candidates; facial contour clearly visible

requirements.content_instructions: JPG, JPEG; 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; 20 KB to 50 KB JPG; 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm; Plain white/light background; Clear frontal view

requirements.requirement_name: Computer Concepts Certificate (80 Hours ICT Skill Certificate)
requirements.content_instructions: PDF; 100 KB to 300 KB PDF scan; A4 original document; Mandatory Chandigarh Administration rule: Certificate of ICT skill course (CCC 80 hours) from a government-recognized institution or NIELIT before issuance of appointment letter

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: Recruitment Notice for the Posts of Junior Basic Training (JBT) and Trained Graduate Teachers (TGT) - Section 6 (Submission of Application) (https://chdeducation.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/JBT_Notice_2024.pdf)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.evidence_reference: Recruitment Notice for the Posts of Junior Basic Training (JBT) and Trained Graduate Teachers (TGT) - Section 6 (Submission of Application) (https://chdeducation.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/JBT_Notice_2024.pdf)
image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: Pixel dimensions transcribed from the cited source.

image_requirements.formats.preferred_for.reasoning: The body lists permitted formats without naming a preference. JPEG is selected from the permitted list; JPG and JPEG name the same format, so this chooses a spelling rather than a format.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.
